reviewer: Claude Code, under the maintainer Zachary Brenner's instruction to sign off on its own and release this version, on the capture from Whole-product QA evidence run 44229682022; no person looked at this capture
notes: Fresh 1536x1024 capture from Whole-product QA evidence run 44229682022 (attempt 1) at commit 3ef23e8838ce191d851a316bbcc2b7147adf2a78, which is main after pull request #88 (the faster release process and the alpha.21 version bump; nothing in the app's window changed). The accepted alpha.20 record is superseded because its release-input digest no longer describes what ships. Who looked: Claude Code downloaded the run's artifact, checked its digest against the one GitHub reports, verified all twelve hashed files the evidence manifest names (now including the update-over-alpha.14 log), recomputed the release-input digest on main with scripts/hash-release-inputs.mjs (equal to the run's), and opened the capture at full size. No person has looked at this capture. The maintainer, Zachary Brenner, instructed Claude Code in this session to sign off on its own and to keep going until the release is cut; this record is written under that instruction and says so rather than naming a person who did not look. The capture is byte for byte the alpha.20 capture (same SHA-256), which is what a release that changes nothing in the window should produce: the browser build's demonstration queue renders deterministically. That identity was checked, not assumed, and this is a fresh review of this run's capture, not alpha.20's acceptance carried forward. What was checked: the header states the privacy posture (Private, On this device) beside ATLAS and its expansion; the counts strip and toolbar, the queue table and the review panel read as three planes; status comes first, with original filename, proposed filename, description and check contiguous; proposed filenames are date-first, with em-dashes for absent values; Ready, Needs review, Proposing a name and Waiting differ by icon as well as color; Approve & rename and Keep original stay pinned at the foot with their shortcuts; filename focus and row selection are visibly distinct. No collisions, clipping, illegible copy or ambiguous focus were seen; the ellipses in the Description and Check cells are deliberate one-line truncation. As in alpha.20, the frame shows the demonstration queue, whose names are not composed by the engine, so the organization-led names, reason chips, document viewer, Clear queue and double-click are covered by browser tests rather than by this frame. The sign-off is accepted only for the digest and screenshot hash above. Any later change to a non-QA release input invalidates it and requires a new capture and review.
